name: Dolibarr
title: Dolibarr ERP & CRM

description.en: Open-source ERP and CRM web suite for managing business activities.
description.zh: 用于管理企业业务活动的开源 ERP 与 CRM Web 套件。
description.zh-Hant: 用於管理企業業務活動的開源 ERP 與 CRM Web 套件。

zh.introduction: 是一套面向企业、基金会和自由职业者的开源 ERP 与 CRM Web 应用，可集中管理客户、供应商、销售、财务和运营活动。

features.title: 客户与供应商管理
features.description: 统一管理客户、供应商、联系人及相关业务信息。

features.title: 销售与财务流程
features.description: 支持报价、订单、发票、付款和会计等业务流程。

features.title: 运营管理
features.description: 覆盖库存、日程、人力资源、费用报销、文档和制造等场景。

features.title: 模块化扩展
features.description: 可按组织需要启用功能模块并安装外部模块。

en.introduction: is an open-source ERP and CRM web application for businesses, foundations, and freelancers, bringing customer, supplier, sales, finance, and operations management together.

features.title: Customer and Supplier Management
features.description: Manage customers, suppliers, contacts, and related business information.

features.title: Sales and Finance Workflows
features.description: Handle proposals, orders, invoices, payments, and accounting workflows.

features.title: Operations Management
features.description: Cover stock, agenda, HR, expense reports, documents, and manufacturing.

features.title: Modular Extensions
features.description: Enable built-in features and install external modules as needed.

notes: The database is selected from 1Panel-managed MySQL or MariaDB services through the official PANEL_DB_* form variables.
After generation, remove any extra top-level PANEL_DB_HOST text field; PANEL_DB_HOST is already declared by the official nested service selector.
After generation, keep DOLI_INIT_DEMO default and select values quoted as strings; 1Panel AppFormValue.value does not accept YAML numbers.
Specialized form labels use English fallback outside Chinese when no official translation was available.
The generated package still requires lifecycle testing on a 1Panel host.
Cross-major-version updates are disabled pending a tested 1Panel and Dolibarr database migration procedure.
Keep the 23.0.3 version directory so 1Panel can offer 23.0.4 as an upgrade target; the 23.0.4/scripts/upgrade.sh removes install.lock after 1Panel backup and before the new container starts.
The package generator does not create upgrade.sh; preserve the reviewed 23.0.4/scripts/upgrade.sh when regenerating the version directory.
